title: Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Uruguay, featuring tender beef and a rich blend of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the beef from the pot.
Add the onion, carrot, and potato to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the Uruguayan earthy spices blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine and beef broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 hours.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
